trusted_plaintext_access: Replica sync exports plaintext only with both the replicator credential and the bound node private key (signed, counter-protected request); every export is audited.
Admin credentials can acquire all resource plaintext through audited ownership changes; admin sync is forbidden.
replica_audit: Signed local reads are uploaded and acknowledged on sync; partitions delay visibility.
clock_assumption: Monotonic node clock progresses through suspension; lease bound L/(1-rho).
revocation_everywhere: Revoke, rotate, role change, transfer and recovery return effective_everywhere_at_ms = latest pre-revocation lease expiry (rho = 1%); replicas may serve the revoked key until then, the authority never does.
at_rest: Master key is beside the database; protects database-only disclosure, not whole-directory theft.
log_integrity: Signed SHA-384 chain plus RFC 9162 Merkle tree; audit answers carry inclusion proofs; tree heads signed with ML-DSA-65 and SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s; CWE-117 prevented by per-record canonical JSON.
self_detection: Post-signature attacks (revoked/expired key, disabled actor, stale epoch, signed replay) become bounded signed security.alert events naming identity, key, node and event; response revokes the actor's dashboard tokens and pending offers. Pre-signature rejections are only counted.
messaging_limits: Hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768 one-time offers per message; no Double Ratchet/PQXDH post-compromise healing; no session resumption.
